messages:
Hannah: Quick follow-up from the monthly recurrence sprint. We surfaced recurring vectors: aggressive downscaling, KV eviction cascades, and intermittent model rollbacks. Need clear owners, one-line actions, and short playbook snippets so oncall can triage faster.

Vik: I can take downscaling. Short term: bump graceful window 30->90s for warm pools and pause downscales during backup windows. Rollout: canary pool -> 24h -> full. ETA: 2026-04-06. Playbook: 1) increase graceful window, 2) disable aggressive policy, 3) route traffic to warm pool.

Liam: I'll own KV eviction. Proposed: enable hot-prefix caching + cap client batch-size variance at ingress. Rollout: feature flag -> region canary -> global. ETA: 2026-04-14. Playbook: 1) set cache to readonly, 2) flip hot-prefix flag, 3) scale cache nodes.

Zoe: I'll take model rollbacks. Short-term: add tokenization preflight and checksum parity in swap pipeline; block swap on mismatch >0.2%. ETA: 2026-04-20. Playbook: 1) revert model variant, 2) run tokenization check, 3) notify model-onboarding.

remedy-bot: ticket created: #INC-2026-1602 "Recurrence: sprint handoff" linked to thread

Hannah: Please paste one-line items in the importable format: "owner | action | ETA" so I can load to the recurrence board. Also confirm ownership with a quick :white_check_mark:.

Vik: "Vik | bump graceful window + backup gating | 2026-04-06" :white_check_mark:

Liam: "Liam | enable hot-prefix cache + batch-size cap | 2026-04-14" :white_check_mark:

Zoe: "Zoe | add tokenization preflight + checksum gate | 2026-04-20" :white_check_mark:

Hannah: Thanks. I'll import these and create low-threshold alerts for the new dashboards (cache hit rate, pod churn, 5xx). Follow-up sync in 7 days to review canary metrics and rebalance ownership if needed. Closing thread, will reopen if blockers crop up. :rocket:
